useCases.title: Four user roles, one role per user
postconditions: The user's role name is shown in the header of every screen
mainFlow: 1. Every user is assigned exactly one of: Shipping Agent, Berth Officer, Harbour Master, Inspector.
2. The role name is displayed in the header on every screen.

useCases.title: Harbour Master is a superset of Berth Officer
postconditions: Harbour Master can perform every Berth Officer action plus overrides, agent reactivation and tariff maintenance
mainFlow: 1. The Harbour Master can perform every action a Berth Officer can.
2. Additionally: override a Rejected decision (F004), reactivate a suspended agent (F002), and maintain tariffs (F005).

useCases.title: Agents see only their own company's data
postconditions: Agent's booking/invoice/inspection lists are scoped to their own company (ShippingAgent) only
mainFlow: 1. A Shipping Agent user can only see BookingRequest, Invoice and Inspection records that belong to bookings made by their own ShippingAgent company.
